rules: theme.themeId must exist in the public thematic index
IDs must be unique across elements and distinctions
subaxis parentId must reference an axis or subaxis
attached complement parentId must reference an axis or subaxis; null is allowed
every substantive element and distinction must have at least one evidenceRef
every evidenceRef must resolve to an existing canonical recordId containing the artifact themeId
canonical source file is derived from recordId book number and must contain that recordId
distinctions require at least two non-empty sides
side relatedElementIds must reference existing axes/subaxes
